_doc: Example icon standard for make_icons.py. Copy to <repo>/.labview/conventions/icon-spec.json and edit. classes: owner key (the class folder name, a flat folder, the top-level owner or a library owner) -> banner (3x5 font: A-Z 0-9 - _ . > space, max 7), web-safe colour (multiples of 33 hex), lib_glyph. libs: .lvlib icons. no_template: classes entries without a .lvclass; library_owners: owners whose .lvlib is the template of their VIs; flat_folders: first-level src folders drawn flat. overrides: owner -> VI file -> lib_glyph + glyph. rules: ordered name rules (match contains|prefix|suffix|equals; first: true runs before the built-in Read/Write/Send/Do rules), checked before the built-in rules. lib_glyphs (10x10) and glyphs (16x16): row strings over palette keys, '.' transparent. planned: VIs not built yet (--include-planned).
